messages:
Alex R: Quick heads-up — Azure GovCloud listing with EdgeHW is moving fast. We need to lock down the security artifacts before the joint announcement. Who owns the SOC report + pen scope?
Mei Chen: I can coordinate with the EdgeHW SI. Do we need full SOC2 Type II or a scoped summary for the marketplace listing? :thinking_face: 
Raj Patel: For marketplace listing we normally accept a SOC2 bridge letter + pen-test summary if full report is still in redaction. For GovCloud they often want the assessor name and the test window.
Sofie (Security): Confirming — assessor (3rd party) + pen date range required. Also need evidence that critical infra (KMS, network egress controls) were included in scope.
Elena (SI): From the integrator side: EdgeHW will only allow a limited asset list — firmware + device mgmt plane + partner gateway. We need to be explicit about excluded assets (e.g., end-customer networks).
Alex R: Ok — can we put a short scope doc together? Mei, can you own a single-page checklist we can hand to EdgeHW and the assessor?
Mei Chen: Yep. Drafting now. Rough checklist items: 1) SOC2 status + date, 2) Pen test vendor & window, 3) Scoped assets (firmware, gateway, control plane), 4) Redaction point of contact, 5) Presigned artifact links TTL.
Raj Patel: Add: 6) Confirm KMS/HSM coverage and whether logs were included (audit trail). 7) Any public CVEs in firmware and mitigation notes.
Sofie (Security): Also include a request for the pen-test executive summary cover page (findings summary) — full finding details can be redacted but we need severity counts.
Alex R: Perfect. One more ask — marketing wants to sync the press announcement with the pen window close. Can we get ETA on when assessor will hand over the summary?
Elena (SI): EdgeHW procurement said vendor expects 2 weeks turnaround after test window closes. So if pen window ends Apr 7, we should have a summary by Apr 21.
Mei Chen: I'll circulate the checklist + a template email to send to assessor + EdgeHW today.
Raj Patel: Quick technical note (copy for checklist):```
Assets in-scope: edge-device-firmware, edge-gateway, control-plane-api, partner-auth-service
Excluded: customer-networks, third-party-managed-sensors
Evidence types: SOC2 attestation pdf, pen-test exec summary pdf, presigned artifact links (s3), log-retention policy doc
```
Sofie (Security): Good. Also set presigned links TTL to 7 days and require upload to our secure ingest bucket with access logs.
Alex R: Thanks team. Mei — when you post the checklist, tag @Sofie so she can sign off on the redaction guidance.
Mei Chen: Will do. Posting in 30m. :thumbsup: 
VendorBot: Automated reminder: create a secure artifact presign request at https://internal.redwood/secure-upload once you have the assessor files.
Alex R: Adding last item — who will be the external contact for press if the findings are minor? Marketing needs a fallback.
Elena (SI): EdgeHW has a press contact (anna.edge@edgehw.com). I'll DM the marketing lead.
Mei Chen: Uploaded checklist draft: https://internal.redwood/docs/edgehw-market-preflight-v1 (internal link). Please review before EOD.
Sofie (Security): Reviewing now. Will comment on redaction rules and confirm acceptance by EOD. :eyes:
